account.language_hint: Independent of the language the bot speaks.
account.password_revokes: Your other open sessions will be closed.
account.title: My account
alerts.intro: The bot sends a WhatsApp message to every owner when one of these events happens. Switch off the ones you do not want. Each type has its own rate limit, so a bad hour never floods your phone.
alerts.limits_note: Rate limits: one errors-in-series alert per hour, one refused-key alert per service every 24 hours, one blocked-login alert per origin every 15 minutes, one reconnection alert every 10 minutes and one update alert per version.
alerts.no_recipient: No owner is configured, so alerts cannot be delivered and are dropped. Add at least one owner number in the settings (the owners list).
alerts.pending_note: An alert raised while the bot is disconnected waits and is sent as soon as it is connected again. After 24 hours it expires.
alerts.recent_empty: No alert has been raised yet.
alerts.recent_empty_hint: Alerts appear here as soon as one of the events above happens.
alerts.summary: {enabled} of {total} alert types enabled, {pending} waiting to be sent.
alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.toggle_unavailable: This switch is unavailable: the matching setting was not found.
alerts.type_errors_series_desc: 10 command errors within 10 minutes. The message names the commands involved.
alerts.type_key_refused_desc: A service rejected the configured API key during a real use.
alerts.type_login_blocked_desc: An origin failed to log in to the panel 5 times and is blocked for 15 minutes.
alerts.type_new_origin_desc: Someone logged in to the panel from an address that had never logged in before.
alerts.type_reconnected_desc: The bot is connected again after more than 5 minutes without a connection.
alerts.type_update_available_desc: A newer version of the bot exists. Announced once per version.
app.name: Admin panel
audit.empty: No action has been recorded yet.
audit.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date.
audit.title: Action history
auth.blocked: Too many failed sign-in attempts from this address. Try again in {retryAfter}.
auth.no_account: No administrator account exists yet. Open the bot console and follow the setup link printed at startup (valid for 30 minutes).
auth.password_rule: At least {min} characters. Avoid repeated characters, simple sequences and common passwords.
auth.reset_intro: Choose a new password. Every open session will be closed.
auth.setup_intro: Choose the administrator password of the panel. There is a single account.
auth.setup_invalid: This setup link is invalid, expired or already used.
auth.setup_invalid_reset: An account exists: run “node tools/admin-reset.js” on the server to get a reset link.
auth.setup_invalid_restart: Restart the bot to get a new link in its console.
backup.absent_note: {count} data types are not in this file, so they will be emptied: {list}.
backup.blocker_passphrase_required: Enter the passphrase of the file.
backup.contents_excluded: Never included: the panel account and its sessions, the history of actions, the alert state and the AI conversation history.
backup.contents_included: Included: the settings (API keys too, decrypted inside the encrypted file), disabled commands, custom bot texts, group data, statistics, reminders and broadcasts with their media.
backup.done_message: The data was restored. A copy of the previous data is kept in {file}.
backup.export_done: {name} ({size}) was downloaded. Keep the passphrase safe.
backup.export_intro: The file is encrypted with the passphrase you choose. Keep that passphrase safe: without it the file cannot be opened.
backup.failed_kept: The previous data was kept: nothing was changed.
backup.failed_reason_file_altered: The file was altered or cut short while it was being applied.
backup.failed_reason_other: An unexpected error occurred. See the logs.
backup.failed_reason_secret_storage_unav: The secret key of this installation could not be written.
backup.failed_replaced: The data had already been replaced when this step failed. Check the dashboard and restart the bot.
backup.file_hint: The file made by the export above, from this bot or from another one.
backup.ignored_column: Column {column} of {model} no longer exists ({rows} rows).
backup.ignored_model: Data type {model} is unknown to this version ({rows} rows).
backup.ignored_settings: {count} settings cannot be restored here (unknown or fixed at start-up).
backup.ignored_texts: {count} custom texts no longer fit this version and are skipped.
backup.include_session_hint: Off by default. Only needed to move the bot to another server without scanning the QR code again.
backup.intro: Export all the bot's data to one encrypted file, or restore a file made earlier. The file is protected by a passphrase that nobody can recover for you.
backup.passphrase_hint: At least {min} characters. It is never stored or logged.
backup.progress_note: Keep this page open. Changes are paused and the bot restarts at the end.
backup.refusal_backup_corrupted: The file is altered or incomplete. Download it again from where it came from.
backup.refusal_backup_invalid_row: The file holds an invalid record: data type {model}, position {index}, field {field}. Nothing was changed.
backup.refusal_backup_too_new: This backup was made by a newer version of the bot ({backupVersion}); this one is {currentVersion}. Update the bot first.
backup.refusal_backup_unsupported_format: This is not a backup this version can read.
backup.refusal_busy: Another export, restore or maintenance operation is running. Try again when it is over.
backup.refusal_maintenance: A restore is being applied: changes are refused for now.
backup.refusal_not_found: The file is no longer available on the server (it expires after one hour). Choose it again.
backup.refusal_payload_too_large: The file is too large for the upload limit ({maxBytes} bytes). Raise MAX_UPLOAD in the settings.
backup.refusal_quota_exceeded: The space reserved for pending uploads is full. Try again in a few minutes.
backup.refusal_rate_limited: The key computation is busy with other requests. Try again in a few seconds.
backup.refusal_restore_token_invalid: The check has expired or does not belong to this session. Choose the file again.
backup.refusal_unsupported_file_type: This file is not a backup made by this bot.
backup.refusal_upload_in_progress: Another file is already being sent from this session.
backup.refusal_wrong_passphrase: Wrong passphrase. Use the one chosen when the file was exported (watch the case and the accents).
backup.replace_warning: Restoring replaces ALL the data listed above. The bot restarts at the end. A copy of the current data is kept in the list below.
backup.restore_confirm_message: All the current data will be replaced by the backup of {date}, and the bot will restart. This cannot be undone from here, except through the safety copy made just before.
backup.restore_intro: The file is checked first and nothing changes until you confirm. A copy of the current data is made automatically before the restore.
backup.session_confirm_message: The file will allow taking over the WhatsApp number of the bot, as long as the passphrase is known. Continue only if you understand this.
backup.session_warning: With the session, whoever holds the file and the passphrase can take over the WhatsApp number of the bot. Keep the file private.
backup.stored_intro: The last three are kept. They are encrypted with the passphrase of the file that was restored: use the restore above to go back to that state.
backup.stored_title: Safety copies made before a restore
backup.summary_session_no: Not included: the current one is kept
backup.summary_session_yes: Included: it will replace the current one
backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.token_expired: The check has expired. Choose the file again to start over.
backup.two_installations_warning: Do not restore the same file on two installations that are both running: reminders and scheduled broadcasts could be sent twice.
backup.verifying: Checking the content of the file...
backup.warning_media_not_restored: Some broadcast media could not be put back in place.
backup.warning_reload_failed: The settings and texts could not be reloaded. Restart the bot from the dashboard.
backup.warning_restart: The bot did not confirm its restart. Check the dashboard and restart it if needed.
backup.warning_session_not_swapped: The WhatsApp session could not be replaced; the current one is still in use.
backup.warning_status_not_restored: The status-save settings file could not be restored.
banners.db_unavailable: The database is unreachable: only the pages that do not need it work.
banners.invalid_file_values: Invalid values in the configuration file were replaced by defaults: {keys}.
banners.logged_out: The device was unlinked from WhatsApp: the bot is signed out. Pair it again.
banners.maintenance: A restore is being applied ({phase}): changes are suspended.
banners.no_https: Unencrypted connection: your password and session travel in clear text. Use HTTPS (a reverse proxy) unless you are on the local machine.
banners.no_owner: No owner is configured (SUDO): owner commands and alerts have no recipient.
banners.restart_needed: Saved settings only apply after the bot restarts: {keys}.
banners.restore_interrupted: A previous restore was interrupted; the earlier state was kept. Restart the bot to clear this notice.
banners.secret_key_lost: The key that encrypts stored secrets (data/panel.key) is missing or unreadable. Enter these values again: {keys}.
banners.secret_key_lost_unknown: The key that encrypts stored secrets (data/panel.key) is missing or unreadable, so the stored secrets cannot be read. Enter them again.
banners.undeclared_proxy: Proxy headers ({headers}) arrive from an undeclared address, so every visitor shares one origin. Declare your proxy with PANEL_TRUST_PROXY, then restart the bot.
banners.update_restart: Update applied ({from} → {to}). Restart the program to finish.
broadcasts.cancel_message: Messages not yet sent will not be sent. A message already on its way still arrives.
broadcasts.confirm_message: The message goes to {count} destinations. This cannot be undone once sent.
broadcasts.confirm_message_one: The message goes to {count} destination. This cannot be undone once sent.
broadcasts.confirm_mismatch: The number of destinations changed: it is now {count}. Review the preview and confirm again.
broadcasts.confirm_mismatch_one: The number of destinations changed: it is now {count}. Review the preview and confirm again.
broadcasts.delete_message: The broadcast, its {count} occurrences, their reports and its file are deleted for good.
broadcasts.delete_message_one: The broadcast, its occurrence, its report and its file are deleted for good.
broadcasts.edit_intro: Changes apply to the next occurrences only; occurrences already prepared keep their destinations.
broadcasts.empty_hint: Create one to send a message to several chats.
broadcasts.error_connection_closed: The connection closed during the send
broadcasts.error_error: The message could not be sent
broadcasts.error_forbidden: WhatsApp refused the message (the bot may have left the group)
broadcasts.error_interrupted: The bot stopped during the send
broadcasts.error_timeout: No answer from WhatsApp in time
broadcasts.failed_summary: {failed} destinations failed; {selectable} of them can be served again by a new broadcast, {unsure} may already have received the message.
broadcasts.failed_summary_one: {failed} destination failed; {selectable} of them can be served again by a new broadcast, {unsure} may already have received the message.
broadcasts.failed_unselectable_one: {count} is no longer a valid destination.
broadcasts.field_run_at_hint: In your browser's time zone. If the bot is not running within an hour of that time, the message is not sent.
broadcasts.field_spacing_hint: From 2 to 600 seconds. A short random delay is added to each pause, and messages are never sent faster than every 2 seconds.
broadcasts.field_title_hint: Only for you, to recognise the broadcast in the list.
broadcasts.intro: Send a message to chosen chats, now, later or on a schedule. Messages go out one at a time with a pause between them, and never twice to the same chat.
broadcasts.media_gone_hint: The file was deleted 7 days after the broadcast ended. Upload it again to send it in a new broadcast.
broadcasts.media_hint: One file at most. The text becomes its caption, limited to {caption} characters.
broadcasts.new_to_failed: New broadcast to the failed destinations
broadcasts.new_to_failed_hint: A failed message is never sent again on its own, because it may already have arrived. This opens the creation form with the same text and the failed destinations ticked; you review it and confirm.
broadcasts.not_selectable: No longer a valid destination (group left or bot disabled there)
broadcasts.note_late: Skipped: the bot was not running within the hour
broadcasts.nothing_changed: Nothing to save: no field was changed.
broadcasts.paused_disconnected_hint: Sending resumes, at the usual pace, as soon as the bot is connected again.
broadcasts.picker_caption: Chats that can receive a broadcast
broadcasts.picker_empty_hint: Change the search, or wait until a chat writes to the bot.
broadcasts.picker_hint: Pick from the chats the bot knows. A phone number cannot be typed in: a chat appears here once it has written to the bot or once the bot is in the group.
broadcasts.prefill_media_gone: The original file was deleted: upload it again if the message needs it.
broadcasts.prefill_notice: New broadcast to the failed destinations: {count} destinations ticked. Review them, untick any you do not want, then preview and confirm.
broadcasts.prefill_notice_one: New broadcast to the failed destination: {count} destination ticked. Review it, untick any you do not want, then preview and confirm.
broadcasts.prefill_skipped: {count} failed destinations are left out because they are no longer valid destinations.
broadcasts.prefill_skipped_one: {count} failed destination is left out because it is no longer a valid destination.
broadcasts.prefill_unsure: {count} of them may already have received the message and are marked: untick them if you prefer not to send twice.
broadcasts.prefill_unsure_one: {count} of them may already have received the message and is marked: untick it if you prefer not to send twice.
broadcasts.resumed_done: Recurring message resumed from now, without catching up.
broadcasts.rule_day_hint: In a shorter month, a day that does not exist (such as the 31st) fires on the last day of the month.
broadcasts.rule_late_hint: An occurrence that could not start within an hour of its time (for example because the bot was off) is skipped and noted in the history.
broadcasts.rule_monthly: On day {day} of every month at {time}
broadcasts.rule_monthly_last: On day {day} of every month at {time} (the last day of shorter months)
broadcasts.rule_time_hint: In the bot's time zone (the TIMEZONE setting).
broadcasts.runs_empty_once: The occurrence appears as soon as it is prepared.
broadcasts.runs_empty_recurring: The first occurrence appears when its time comes.
broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.unsure_hint: The message may already have reached this chat, so it is not sent again on its own.
broadcasts.warning_bot_disconnected: The bot is disconnected: sending would wait until it is connected again.
broadcasts.when_later: Schedule for a date and time
commands.access_admin_hint: Reserved for group admins and owners
commands.editor_add_hint: Group identifier ending with @g.us. You can copy it from the Groups page.
commands.editor_global_hint: Turn this off to refuse the command in every chat. A global switch-off wins over the groups below.
commands.editor_groups_hint: The command is refused in these groups only and works everywhere else.
commands.editor_groups_ignored: The command is already off everywhere: these groups have no effect until it is switched back on.
commands.intro: Switch commands off everywhere or in chosen groups. The change applies from the next message, to every alias, and owners are refused too. Message hooks such as AFK or filters keep running.
commands.no_match_hint: Change the search or the category.
commands.orphans_hint: These switch-offs name a command that is not loaded any more (an alias was renamed). They do nothing: you can remove them.
commands.orphans_title: Rows for commands that no longer exist
commands.search_placeholder: Search by name, alias or description
commands.summary: {shown} of {total} commands shown; {off} switched off somewhere.
commands.title: Commands
commands.warn_ban: Disabling ban can lock a chat out of the bot: the panel is then the only way back.
commands.warn_unban: Disabling unban means a chat switched off with ban can only be switched back on from the panel.
common.unsaved_message: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now they will be lost.
common.view_error: This page could not be displayed
common.view_error_hint: Try again, or reload the page if the problem persists.
confirm.disruptive_message: The bot may be unavailable for a short while.
dashboard.pairing_hint: The bot is waiting to be paired with a WhatsApp account.
dashboard.polling: Live updates are paused: the page refreshes every 2 seconds.
dashboard.restart_blocked_job: Another operation is running. Restart again when it has finished.
dashboard.restart_blocked_maintenance: A restore is being applied: the restart is unavailable until it ends.
dashboard.restart_failed: The restart failed ({reason}). Check the logs.
dashboard.restart_message: The bot reconnects and reloads its settings. The WhatsApp session is kept, but the bot does not answer for a few seconds.
dashboard.restart_reason_timeout: the connection did not come back in time
dashboard.title: Dashboard
data.chat_hint: Optional: the identifier of a group or of a private chat.
data.confirm_cancel_message.reminders: The reminder will not be sent.
data.confirm_clear_message.afk: The member will no longer be shown as away. Their other data is kept.
data.confirm_delete_message.ideas: The idea is removed from the idea box. This cannot be undone.
data.confirm_delete_message.keywords: The keyword stops alerting its member. This cannot be undone.
data.confirm_delete_message.quotes: The quote is removed. This cannot be undone.
data.confirm_delete_message.sticker-comm: The sticker no longer runs its command. This cannot be undone.
data.confirm_delete_message.tasks: The task is removed from the list of its chat. This cannot be undone.
data.done_cancelled: Reminder cancelled. It will not be sent.
data.economy_adjust_intro: Add or remove coins, or set a balance. A balance never goes below zero, and what happens at the same time in the group is kept.
data.economy_group_hint: Takes the place of the list above. Ends with @g.us.
data.economy_member_hint: A phone number or a WhatsApp identifier. Click Adjust in the list to fill it in.
data.economy_mode_hint_set: The balance becomes exactly this amount (zero or more).
data.economy_no_group_hint: Balances are kept per group: pick a group in the list, or type its identifier.
data.economy_reason_hint: Required, at most {max} characters. Kept in the history of actions.
data.empty_hint.economy: Balances appear once members use the economy commands.
data.empty_hint.ideas: Ideas are posted with the idea box command.
data.empty_hint.quotes: Quotes are saved with the quote command.
data.empty_hint.reminders: Reminders created with .remind appear here until they are sent.
data.empty_hint.sticker-commands: Bind a sticker to a command with .setcmd.
data.intro.afk: Members who marked themselves away. Clearing a status does not delete the member.
data.intro.economy: Coin balances of the members of one group. Adjust a balance with a reason: it is kept in the history.
data.intro.ideas: Ideas posted in the idea box of the groups.
data.intro.keywords: Words that alert a member by private message when they appear in a group.
data.intro.reminders: Reminders waiting to be sent. A cancelled reminder is never sent.
data.intro.sticker-commands: Stickers bound to a command with .setcmd.
data.no_match_hint: Change the search or the filters.
data.page_intro: What the bot's commands keep in the database: reminders, balances, keyword alerts, sticker commands, away statuses, tasks, ideas and quotes. A change applies to the very next command.
data.title: Bot data
errors.already_paired: A WhatsApp account is already paired. Log it out first.
errors.backup_corrupted: The backup is altered or incomplete.
errors.backup_invalid_row: A row of the backup is invalid (model {model}, position {index}, field {field}).
errors.backup_too_new: This backup comes from a newer bot version ({backupVersion}, installed: {currentVersion}).
errors.bot_not_admin: The bot must be an administrator of the group to do this.

errors.conflict: The data changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.

errors.db_unavailable: The database is unreachable right now.
errors.downloads_active: Downloads are running. Try again later.
errors.group_left: The bot is no longer in this group.

errors.maintenance: A restore is being applied: changes are refused for now.
errors.negative_balance: The balance would become negative: nothing was changed.

errors.no_qr: No QR code is available right now.
errors.not_configured: No key is saved for this service.
errors.not_connected: The bot is not connected to WhatsApp.
errors.not_editable: This item cannot be edited in its current state.
errors.not_pending: This item is no longer pending.
errors.origin_mismatch: Request refused: the origin does not match. If you use a reverse proxy, check PANEL_PUBLIC_URL.
errors.payload_too_large: The file or request is too large (maximum {maxBytes} bytes).

errors.setup_required: No account exists yet: follow the link printed in the bot console.
errors.starting: The bot is still starting up. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.target_protected: This target is protected (the bot, an owner or the group creator).

errors.unsupported_file_type: This file type is not accepted.
errors.update_unavailable: Automatic update is not possible here ({blockers}).
errors.upload_in_progress: A file upload is already in progress.
errors.validation_failed: Some values are invalid. Fix the highlighted fields.
errors.whatsapp_error: The WhatsApp call failed. Try again.
fields.conflict: This setting changed since the page was opened (version {version}).
fields.in_past: The date is in the past.
fields.invalid_phone: Invalid number (digits with the country code, 8 to 15 digits).
fields.same_as_current: The new password must differ from the current one.
fields.too_weak: Password too weak: avoid repeated characters, simple sequences and common passwords.
groups.antibot_hint: Removes senders whose message identifier no WhatsApp app produces. Ambiguous cases are only logged, never removed.
groups.antilink_hint: A link posted by a member is deleted and the member is warned, then removed at the warning limit. A command that contains a link is deleted too and does not run.
groups.commands_intro: Switch off the commands that should not work here. A command that is off everywhere cannot be switched on from this page.
groups.delete_done: Settings deleted ({filters} filters, {roles} roles, {warnings} warnings, {commandStates} disabled commands).
groups.delete_hint: The bot has left this group. You can delete the settings kept for it: messages, filters, roles, warnings and disabled commands. Balances, ideas, quotes, tasks and statistics are kept.
groups.disable_confirm_message: It will stop answering in this group, to commands as well as with welcome messages.
groups.disable_done: The bot is disabled in this group.
groups.disable_hint: When the bot is disabled here it ignores every message, commands included. You can switch it back on here or from the list of disabled chats.
groups.disable_label: Disable the bot in this group
groups.disabled_empty_hint: A chat appears here when the bot is disabled in it.
groups.disabled_enabled: The bot answers again in this chat.
groups.disabled_intro: The bot ignores every message in these chats, commands included, until it is switched back on.
groups.empty_hint: Groups appear once the bot is connected and has been added to a group.
groups.enable_done: The bot is active in this group.
groups.exempt_hint: Group administrators and bot owners are never affected.
groups.filter_delete_message: The bot will stop answering to “{pattern}”.
groups.filter_pattern_hint: Plain text, up to {max} characters. It is never used as a regular expression.
groups.filters_empty_hint: Add a pattern and the response the bot should send.
groups.filters_intro: When a member's message contains the pattern as a whole word or phrase (case ignored), the bot sends the response.
groups.goodbye_hint: Posted when members leave or are removed.
groups.intro: Choose a group to set its welcome and goodbye messages, its protection, filters, member roles and warnings. Changes apply from the next message.
groups.lockout_ban: Without this command, the bot can no longer be disabled from a chat; use this panel instead.
groups.lockout_unban: Without this command, a chat where the bot is disabled can only be switched back on from this panel.
groups.members_unavailable: The member list is not available ({reason}); only the members that already have a role are shown.
groups.mute_confirm_message: Members will not be able to send messages until you switch this off.
groups.mute_hint: Changes the WhatsApp group setting. The switch shows the last state set by the bot; an administrator can change it from a phone.
groups.never_refreshed: Member counts and administrator status stay unknown until the list is refreshed.
groups.no_match_hint: Change the search or the filter.
groups.not_found_hint: The panel has never seen this group. Refresh the list while the bot is connected.
groups.protection_intro: These rules only work while the bot is a group administrator.
groups.refresh_cached: The list was refreshed less than a minute ago.
groups.roles_empty_hint: The roles you give appear here.
groups.roles_intro: VIP members cannot be warned. The messages of muted members are deleted. Banned members are removed. Roles only apply while the bot is a group administrator.
groups.template_reset_message: The custom text is replaced by the standard message, in the language of the bot.
groups.title: Groups
groups.unknown_hint: Not known yet: refresh the list while the bot is connected
groups.variable_user: The member who joined or left
groups.warning_bot_not_admin: The bot is not an administrator of this group: anti-link, anti-bot and mute cannot be enforced until it is promoted. The settings are saved anyway.
groups.warnings_intro: A member who reaches {limit} warnings is removed from the group.
groups.warnings_reset_all_message: Every member of the group will start again at zero.
groups.warnings_reset_all_title: Reset every warning of the group?
groups.welcome_hint: Posted when members join the group.
logs.filter_level_hint: Shows this level and everything more severe.
logs.summary: {shown} of {held} entries shown (the last 1,000 are kept).
logs.title: Logs
maintenance.ahead: {count} local commit(s) are not on GitHub.
maintenance.already_up_to_date: Already up to date: nothing was installed.
maintenance.applied_manual: Updated from {from} to {to}. Restart the program to finish.
maintenance.applied_restarting: Updated from {from} to {to}. The bot is restarting to load it.
maintenance.apply_confirm_manual: Version {from} will be replaced by {to} ({count} change(s)). The new code is tested before it is kept, and the update is rolled back if the test fails. Afterwards you must restart the program yourself: nothing restarts it automatically here.
maintenance.apply_confirm_supervised: Version {from} will be replaced by {to} ({count} change(s)). The new code is tested before it is kept, and the update is rolled back if the test fails. The bot then restarts by itself and is offline for a few seconds.
maintenance.blocker_archive: This installation was uploaded as an archive: it cannot update itself.
maintenance.blocker_detached: The checkout is not on a branch (detached HEAD). Switch to a branch that follows GitHub, for example “git checkout master”.
maintenance.blocker_dirty_tree: Tracked files have local changes. Commit, stash or discard them first (untracked files do not matter).
maintenance.blocker_dubious_ownership: Git refuses this folder because it belongs to another user. Run “git config --global --add safe.directory” on this folder as the user that runs the bot, or fix the folder's owner.
maintenance.blocker_image: This installation runs from a container image: it cannot update itself.
maintenance.blocker_no_git_binary: Git is not installed on this machine. Install git, then reload this page.
maintenance.blocker_no_remote_branch: The current branch has no counterpart on GitHub (no upstream and no origin/<branch>), so there is nothing to update from. Switch to a branch that follows GitHub, or set the upstream of this one.
maintenance.blocker_not_writable: The bot cannot write to its own folder. Give the user that runs the bot write access to it.
maintenance.blocker_unknown: The update is not possible on this installation.
maintenance.howto_archive: This installation was uploaded as an archive, so it cannot update itself. Upload the new version over the old one while keeping config.env, sessions/, data/ and database.db, then run “yarn install” and restart the bot.
maintenance.howto_image: This installation runs from a container image, which cannot update itself. Pull or rebuild the image and recreate the container (for example “docker compose pull && docker compose up -d”, or “docker compose build --no-cache && docker compose up -d”, or Redeploy on your host). Your data volumes are kept.
maintenance.not_changed: The bot is still on its current version.
maintenance.note_antidelete_cache: Recent messages kept in memory (lost at restart).
maintenance.note_broadcast_media: Images and documents attached to broadcasts.
maintenance.note_database: Size only: the database is never emptied from here.
maintenance.note_logs: Log files written by PM2 (empty under Docker).
maintenance.note_panel_backups: Automatic backups made before a restore.
maintenance.note_temp_media: Files created while processing media; safe to empty.
maintenance.protected_part: of which {size} kept for {count} broadcast(s) that can still be sent
maintenance.purge_confirm_antidelete_cac: {items} cached message(s) will be forgotten. Messages deleted during the last hour can no longer be recovered.
maintenance.purge_confirm_broadcast_medi: Media of finished one-time broadcasts will be deleted. {kept} broadcast(s) that are scheduled or recurring keep their media ({keptBytes}), so they can still be sent.
maintenance.purge_confirm_logs: The log files ({size}) will be emptied. The files stay in place.
maintenance.purge_confirm_panel_backups: The automatic pre-restore backups ({size}) will be deleted. You will no longer be able to go back to the state before a restore.

maintenance.reason_diverged: The local history differs from GitHub (local commits that are not on GitHub), so the update was refused.
maintenance.reason_merge_failed: The new code could not be merged.
maintenance.reason_network: GitHub could not be reached during the download.
maintenance.reason_smoke_failed: The new version did not pass its start-up test.
maintenance.reason_unavailable: This installation cannot update itself right now.
maintenance.reason_unknown: An unexpected error occurred. See the logs.
maintenance.reason_unreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Check the internet connection of the host.
maintenance.restart_pending_auto: An update is installed. The bot is about to restart by itself to load it.
maintenance.restart_pending_manual: An update is installed. Restart the program to finish: nothing restarts it automatically here.
maintenance.rolled_back: The bot went back to the version it was running: nothing changed.
maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.update_status_available: An update is available: version {version}, {count} change(s) to install.
maintenance.update_status_unknown: Press “Check for updates” to find out whether a newer version exists.
maintenance.update_status_up_to_date: The bot is up to date.
maintenance.ytdlp_blocked_downloads: Downloads are running: wait for them to finish.
maintenance.ytdlp_blocked_missing: yt-dlp was not found. Install it, and set YTDLP_PATH if it is not on the PATH.
maintenance.ytdlp_confirm_message: yt-dlp is replaced by its newest version. New downloads wait until it is done (a minute at most).
maintenance.ytdlp_hint_apt: Update it with your package manager (for example “sudo apt install --only-upgrade yt-dlp”), or install the official binary and point YTDLP_PATH at it.
maintenance.ytdlp_hint_official_binary: Install the official binary (from the yt-dlp releases page on GitHub) where the bot can write, and point YTDLP_PATH at it.
maintenance.ytdlp_hint_pip: Update it with “pipx upgrade yt-dlp” or “pip install -U yt-dlp”, or install the official binary and point YTDLP_PATH at it.
maintenance.ytdlp_hint_rebuild_image: In a container the update lives in the container's writable layer and is lost when the container is recreated. Rebuild the image (for example “docker compose build --no-cache”) to keep it.
maintenance.ytdlp_verdict_busy: A download or another update is running.
maintenance.ytdlp_verdict_failed: The update failed. See the logs.
maintenance.ytdlp_verdict_managed_extern: yt-dlp is managed by your system and cannot update itself.
maintenance.ytdlp_verdict_unreachable: The update server could not be reached.

settings.ADMIN_PANEL.desc: Turns this panel on or off at startup. Off only with ADMIN_PANEL=false.
settings.ADMIN_PANEL.label: Admin panel
settings.ALERT_ERROR_BURST.desc: Tell the owners after 10 command errors in 10 minutes. At most one alert an hour.
settings.ALERT_ERROR_BURST.label: Alert: errors in a row
settings.ALERT_KEY_REFUSED.desc: Tell the owners when a service refuses its key. At most one per service a day; the key is never included.
settings.ALERT_KEY_REFUSED.label: Alert: API key refused
settings.ALERT_LOGIN_BLOCKED.desc: Tell the owners when an address is blocked after 5 failed panel sign-ins.
settings.ALERT_LOGIN_BLOCKED.label: Alert: sign-in blocked
settings.ALERT_NEW_ORIGIN.desc: Tell the owners when the panel is signed in to from an address never seen before.
settings.ALERT_NEW_ORIGIN.label: Alert: sign-in from a new address
settings.ALERT_RECONNECT.desc: Tell the owners when the bot reconnects after a cut longer than 5 minutes.
settings.ALERT_RECONNECT.label: Alert: reconnection
settings.ALERT_UPDATE.desc: Tell the owners when a newer version exists. Once per version.
settings.ALERT_UPDATE.label: Alert: update available
settings.ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY.desc: Used by the stock quotes (25 requests a day on the free plan). It cannot be tested: the service accepts any key.
settings.ALPHA_VANTAGE_KEY.label: Alpha Vantage key
settings.ALWAYS_ONLINE.desc: Show the bot as online all the time. Applied at the next restart.
settings.ALWAYS_ONLINE.label: Always online
settings.ANTIBOT_MSG.desc: Sent when the anti-bot guard removes a member. Variable: &mention.
settings.ANTIBOT_MSG.label: Anti-bot message
settings.ANTIDELETE_JID.desc: The chat that receives deleted messages when the mode is “specific chat”: a WhatsApp identifier or a phone number.
settings.ANTIDELETE_JID.label: Anti-delete destination
settings.ANTIDELETE_MODE.desc: Where deleted messages are sent. Same as the antidelete command.
settings.ANTIDELETE_MODE.label: Anti-delete
settings.ANTILINK_MSG.desc: Sent when the anti-link guard removes a member. Variable: &mention.
settings.ANTILINK_MSG.label: Anti-link message
settings.ANTI_DELETE.desc: No effect: use the anti-delete mode setting.
settings.ANTI_DELETE.label: Anti-delete (environment)
settings.APYHUB_API_KEY.desc: No effect today: no feature reads it.
settings.APYHUB_API_KEY.label: ApyHub key
settings.AUTO_READ.desc: No effect today: only statuses are marked as seen (see “View statuses automatically”).
settings.AUTO_READ.label: Automatic read
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_ENABLED.desc: Answer private messages with Gemini. Needs a Gemini key. Same as the ar command.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_ENABLED.label: AI auto responder
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_IGNORE_NUMBERS.d: The auto responder never answers these numbers.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_MAX_DELAY.desc: Upper bound of the human-like pause before an answer. Must not be below the shortest pause.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_MAX_DELAY.label: Longest pause before answering
Upper limit of the simulated “typing…” time.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_MIN_DELAY.desc: Lower bound of the human-like pause before an answer. Must not exceed the longest pause.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_MIN_DELAY.label: Shortest pause before answering
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_PERSONALITY.desc: Instructions that give the auto responder its tone, 1 to 2000 characters.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_RATE_LIMIT.desc: Most answers the auto responder gives to one contact in the window below.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_RATE_LIMIT.label: Answers per contact
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_RATE_WINDOW.desc: Length of the window the limit above applies to.
settings.AUTO_RESPONDER_TYPING_SPEED.des: Simulated typing speed, in characters per second.
settings.AUTO_STATUS_REACT.desc: React to the statuses of your contacts with one of the emojis below.
settings.AUTO_STATUS_REACT.label: React to statuses
settings.AUTO_STATUS_SAVE.desc: Forward the statuses of the numbers listed below to the owners. When the server environment forces it on, it cannot be turned off here.
settings.AUTO_STATUS_SAVE.label: Save statuses
settings.AUTO_STATUS_VIEW.desc: Mark the statuses of your contacts as seen.
settings.AUTO_STATUS_VIEW.label: View statuses automatically
settings.BACKEND_URL.desc: Optional backend for social-media downloads, tried only after yt-dlp. Empty: disabled.

settings.BAILEYS_LOG_LVL.label: WhatsApp library log level

settings.CACHE_MAX_AGE.label: Message cache lifetime
settings.CLOUDMERSIVE_API_KEY.desc: No effect today: no feature reads it.
